scenario: You are on the Swiggy order-tracking team. QA has filed a bug against the live order screen.
symptom: The elapsed-time counter on the order screen shows 1s and never moves after that.

rubric.description: The interval's state update does not depend on a seconds value captured when the effect first ran.
The displayed elapsed time keeps increasing every second, past 1.
The displayed value still advances from a running timer. It is not produced by literal values, a precomputed sequence, or a figure computed once per render with nothing triggering a re-render.
The interval is still cleared when the component unmounts.
